raw.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

Customer Success Consultant - Mirakl Ads (Munich)

About the role

Launched three years ago, Mirakl Ads is Mirakl's global Retail Media technology, empowering eCommerce and Marketplace operators to run successful and profitable Retail Media programs. Now entering a new phase of scale, Mirakl Ads is expanding its client base, developing its media offering, and accelerating its impact across key markets worldwide.

As an Experienced Customer Success Consultant for Mirakl Ads, reporting to the Director of Customer Success, your primary mission is to support Mirakl Ads clients in launching and growing their advertising revenues - from strategy design to day-to-day performance optimization. The ideal candidate is a driven, curious and client-obsessed professional, who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments and brings the energy and structure needed to turn ambition into results.

 

What you will do at Mirakl

The Experienced Customer Success Consultant will have a strong impact on Mirakl Ads growth, managing a portfolio of key clients across all stages of their journey.

  • Lead clients from strategy to implementation: define their Retail Media vision and Mirakl Ads roadmap, design the right organizational setup, co-build a sharp commercial action plan with the right KPIs, and drive execution - ensuring a successful and lasting integration of Retail Media into their business, from first workshops through go-live and beyond
  • Deliver strategic recommendations at business reviews, presenting to client teams and C-levels, sharing market insights and case studies to inspire performance and long-term growth
  • Design and implement the right KPI frameworks to monitor clients' advertising network performance and continuously identify growth levers
  • Support clients in the day-to-day optimization of their Mirakl Ads use (placements, campaign configuration, etc.), ensuring platform adoption and maximizing advertising revenues
  • Lead tailored workshops and training sessions to ensure optimal onboarding and sustained platform mastery over time

 

As part of a growing and structured team, you will also:

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement and industrialization of Customer Success processes and tooling, ensuring scalable and efficient operations as the Mirakl Ads client base grows. Collaborate with BI teams to analyze client activity and monitor advertising network performance
  • Leverage AI tools and capabilities to enhance the way we deliver value to clients and scale our operations - from automating reporting and insights generation to accelerating strategic recommendations and improving the overall client experience
  • Act internally as the voice of the Publisher, providing Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams with actionable insights on how Mirakl Ads fits and solves client needs at scale
  • Stay ahead of market trends and competitive dynamics in the Retail Media industry, translating intelligence into strategic recommendations for clients and internal teams
  • Contribute your vision in meetings with adtech partners to strengthen Mirakl's positioning in the adtech value chain and support the growth of our global Advertising Services initiative

 

What Mirakl is looking for

  • Master's Degree in Business or Engineering
  • 3+ years of experience in retail media, the eCommerce industry, or in a consulting firm with strong exposure to digital advertising and/or marketplace ecosystems
  • Solid knowledge of eCommerce, marketplace, and online advertising, with a strong understanding of adtech value chains
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Strong client-facing and project management skills
  • Highly business-driven with strong analytical skills, thriving in dynamic environments
  • Someone eager to thrive in a scaling business environment, contributing to the continuous improvement of the Mirakl Ads Customer Success practice
  • Fluency in English is a must-have; German and/or French is a strong asset, given our key markets.
  • Self-motivated and energetic, with experience managing multiple internal stakeholders to deliver commercial goals
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Willingness to travel internationally

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. title: Head of Customer Experience
description: The mission: comstruct is building the agentic workforce for European construction. Our agents turn paper delivery notes, fragmented invoices and offline supplier decisions into structured, real-time data and live decisions, embedded inside the largest contractors in Europe and the US. To accelerate this journey, we secured a €12.5M seed financing round from 20VC and Google Ventures , along with top European investors. About the role 🦺 As our Head of Customer Experience you own the entire post-sales journey of our customers. You lead a team that covers everything from Solution Engineering and POV Implementation through Rollout and Adoption to Expansion and Support. Your mission: flawless rollouts and a customer experience that makes comstruct the operating system of every construction site. What you will be building 🏗️ Build and lead the CX org: You hire, develop and coach the team across the entire customer experience journey. From scoping ERP architectures in Solution Engineering to resolving requests in Support. You set the structure, the standards and the pace. Make technical rollouts a machine: POVs, supplier integrations, on-site onboardings and multi-site rollouts - you turn what's currently craftsmanship into a scalable system that gets customers to value in weeks, not quarters. Own the post-sales P&L: You tie customer health to ARR, run strategic QBRs with enterprise decision makers and build the engine that surfaces qualified expansion signals before Sales ever gets involved. Shape the product from the field: You sit in Engineering and Product sprint meetings, drive roadmap prioritization from customer signals and make sure what gets built is what moves accounts forward. What we're looking for ✨ You bring 3-5 years of experience in Solution Engineering, Implementation, Value Engineering or Customer Success in enterprise or mid-market environments with high implementation complexity. Structuring POV execution and scoping complex technical implementations across multiple stakeholders is your core, not a secondary skill. You have led a team for at least 1-2 years , hiring and developing ICs, in an environment where the playbook didn't exist until you wrote it. You don't need to code, but you can read and map an ERP integration, assess what's feasible and push back in a room full of engineers. You are eager to learn the product from scratch and understand it inside out. You drive roadmap prioritization from the field and connect customer feedback to what actually gets built. You have carried commercial ownership in a previous implementation or GTM role. You've qualified upsell, defended pricing and driven expansion. You handle multi-layered enterprise accounts, tough stakeholder conversations and direct feedback without losing composure. You speak German on a native level and are fluent in English . Most growth roles at this level are execution seats: run the campaigns someone else planned, report the numbers, wait for direction. This one isn't that. You'll own performance channels and CRO end-to-end — what we spend, where, and why — and use AI to do the work of a much bigger team.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams — the people in factories, logistics hubs, construction sites, and manufacturing plants who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. raw.description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

AI is the biggest transformation of our lifetime. Most companies know they need to move. Few know how. This is where you come in.

As an Enterprise Deployments Engineer at Langdock, you own the infrastructure that powers our enterprise AI platform across dozens of customer cloud environments. You build the systems that make deploying, monitoring, and operating Langdock scalable, turning what today takes weeks into a repeatable, automated process that works across AWS, Azure, GCP, and self-hosted cloud configurations.

This is not a back-office infrastructure role. Customer-facing work is a core part of what you do. You work directly with IT, security, networking, and compliance teams at some of Europe's largest enterprises, translating their requirements into working infrastructure and navigating their approval processes to move deployments forward. You bring the technical depth to earn trust at the C-level and the clarity to make complex architecture decisions legible to any stakeholder in the room.

You take ownership of the deployment process end to end: from writing the infrastructure code that gets new customers live, to keeping existing deployments running reliably, to driving the initiatives that make our setup scale. You don't wait to be told what needs improving. You see it, you build it, and you ship it.

Based full-time at our Berlin headquarters, you will be a critical technical voice for the team and the first point of contact for any infrastructure and platform questions from colleagues and customers alike.

You are fluent in German (C1+ or native) and English.

What You Will Do

Deployment of the Langdock Platform

  • Deploy the Langdock platform across customer cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP, OpenShift, and others) using infrastructure-as-code

  • Explain the Langdock architecture and build trust with technical and C-level stakeholders in customer meetings

  • Guide customers through the entire deployment process and act as their primary point of contact throughout

  • Adapt and extend infrastructure code to meet each customer's specific requirements

Customer Communication & Requirements

  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customer IT, security, networking, and compliance teams

  • Translate customer requirements (from compliance constraints to networking specifics) into working infrastructure and platform changes

  • Connect customer environments and applications to the platform: networking, access, integrations, and everything required to get a deployment live

  • Communicate clearly and proactively across diverse stakeholder groups. This is a central part of the role, not a side responsibility.

Deployment Operations

  • Coordinate and perform regular version upgrades together with our customers

  • Build and maintain monitoring and alerting for dedicated deployments (e.g. using Datadog)

  • Participate in on-call rotation to keep customer platforms running reliably at all times

  • Drive cost monitoring and efficiency improvements across stacks

  • Reproduce and support resolution of bugs related to single-tenant deployments

Platform Engineering & Scale

  • Professionalize and standardize the deployment setup so it scales across a growing customer base

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and tests to keep infrastructure code high quality

  • Contribute to the product where infrastructure and application meet: from switching to managed identities to improving access control

  • Build self-serve documentation for customers based on their feedback

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You have strong, hands-on cloud engineering experience, ideally across more than one major provider (AWS, Azure, GCP). You have deployed real systems into production and you know what it takes to keep them running reliably in complex enterprise environments. Infrastructure-as-code is second nature to you, not something you reach for when you have to.

  • You are comfortable in customer-facing situations. You can walk a CISO through a security architecture, manage a deployment review with a skeptical IT team, and represent Langdock credibly at the C-level, all in the same week. You don't wait for someone else to take the lead in these conversations.

  • You take ownership. You see what needs to be improved in the deployment setup, the monitoring stack, the documentation, or the security posture, and you make it happen without being asked. You treat every deployment as a chance to make the next one better.

  • You are fluent in German (C1+ or native) and English. A significant share of our enterprise customer communication happens in German.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

Bonus: experience with OpenShift or on-premises deployments, prior work in a security or compliance-heavy environment, or early-stage startup experience where you had to build things that scale from scratch.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Compensation: €80K – €120K • Offers Equity

title: Senior Agronomist - Digital Agronomist Products (all genders)
description: At Klim, we work with farmers and food companies to make regenerative agriculture scalable and financially rewarding for farmers. Through our platform, we help farmers restore soil health, increase biodiversity and capture carbon while creating new, reliable income streams. We’re a Berlin-based AgriTech startup backed by $22M in Series A funding, partnering with global food leaders such as Nestlé and Kaufland to reduce emissions across their supply chains and build long-term resilience. Since 2020, we’ve supported 3,500 farmers managing over 900,000 hectares. If you’re passionate about building a sustainable food system and driving real climate impact, join us and help create a healthier planet! Your mission: You are responsible for translating regenerative agricultural expertise and science in arable farming systems in temperate climates into actionable, scalable digital products for farmers on Klim's platform. You ensure that Klim’s digital products are agronomically sound, farmer-relevant, commercially viable and delivered with high quality. Your responsibilities: Own the agronomic logic behind farmer-facing recommendation and assessment engines. Translate agronomic principles into digital products and clear product and engineering specifications. Own and evolve digital agronomy products, including digital decision-support and assessment tools for farmers Expand Klim’s capabilities for regenerative practices in temperate arable systems, including method prioritization, trade-off assessment, and scientific evidence integration. Own and review agronomic datasets, literature, and assumptions used in digital products. Contribute to roadmap and prioritization decisions based on farmer value, willingness to pay, partner value, technical feasibility, and strategic relevance. Validate agronomic models, algorithms, and prototypes by challenging assumptions, stress-testing outputs against field reality, and approving agronomic soundness before release. Support farmer validation through interviews, feedback analysis, test cases, and field-reality checks. Monitor competitors and support expansion into new markets, geographies, and climate zones. Serve as the internal expert on regenerative arable farming, supporting Product, Sales, Farmer Success, Marketing, Data, and Remote Sensing teams. Review agronomic content, farmer-facing explanations, and English/German copy for accuracy and credibility. Depending on your experience, profile, skills and Klim’s team setup, this role may also include an Agronomy Team Lead scope with responsibility for managing the agronomy team. Manage the agronomy team, translating strategic projects into execution Review team outputs and ensure high standards of agronomic quality, scientific robustness and farmer relevance. Your profile: Agronomic Experience You have 5+ years of experience in agronomy, regenerative agriculture, farm advisory, agricultural science, or a related field. You have strong practical experience working with arable farms through farm management, agronomic advisory, or farmer-facing research. You have a solid academic background in agronomy, agricultural sciences, or a related discipline. You have a deep understanding of regenerative arable farming in temperate climates, including soil health, nutrient management, crop rotations, cover crops, tillage, and reduced-input systems. Skills You can translate agronomic expertise into scalable digital products and critically assess models, algorithms, and recommendations. You exercise strong judgement and can develop solutions in ambiguous or novel situations. You are pragmatic, innovative, and motivated to create scalable value for farmers. You are an effective communicator and collaborator across functions. You have an interest in mentoring or team leadership (a plus, not a requirement). You are comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency while maintaining high-quality standards. Languages You are fluent in English; German is a strong advantage. Your benefits: Opportunity : Be part of our journey from the very beginning, working on an equal footing with the leadership team to build a new company. Impact : Make a daily and active contribution to combating climate change, promoting consumer education, and fostering fair conditions for our climate-conscious farmers. Autonomy : Take ownership of your projects and enjoy a high degree of creative freedom. Flexible work model : At Klim, we foster a flexible, hybrid work approach and facilitate remote work (within the EU). It is advantageous for this role if you live in Berlin or can be present in our office regularly. Additional benefits for Germany-based employees : We offer a subsidy for a membership in Urban Sports Club or the Deutschlandticket, a company pension scheme, plus team lunches (if based in Berlin) and regular team events. At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. All hiring and personnel decisions are made solely based on qualifications, performance, and the needs of the company - ensuring fairness and equal opportunity for all. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for our team in ways you don’t yet realise! Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen , die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen. Dabei denkst du in Systemen : Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen. Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren. Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird. Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit : Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar? Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Themen, koordinierst unterschiedliche Stakeholder und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick. Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Solution Architecture, Technical Consulting, Product Management, Softwareentwicklung oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Business und Technologie. raw.description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der bei uns Newsletter schreibt und sie gleich fertig baut.

Kurz zu uns: Wir sind Rügamer & Steiner aus Düsseldorf, über 35 Leute, und wir machen E-Mail-Marketing für mehr als 150 Online-Shops. In Zahlen: 8 E-Mails pro Sekunde, 250 Millionen Empfänger im Jahr. Jede einzelne Zeile davon hat jemand von uns geschrieben & designt.

Wenn du gerade Texte abgibst und danach nie wieder siehst, was daraus geworden ist: Hier ist es ungefähr das Gegenteil.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben liegen morgens bereit. Ein Shop braucht einen Sale-Newsletter, der nächste stellt eine neue Kategorie vor. Du liest dich ins Briefing ein, überlegst dir den Aufbau, schreibst Betreffzeile und Text, ziehst dir die Blöcke aus unserem Figma-Designsystem und passt die Grafiken an, teilweise mit KI. Dann geht der Newsletter zur Freigabe an den Kunden und raus.

Du betreust 30 bis 40 Marken. Nach ein paar Wochen weißt du, wie jede einzelne klingt.

Qualifikation

  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft: Bei uns wird Vollgas gegeben, 100 % vor Ort mit dem Team in Düsseldorf.
  • Auge für Ästhetik: Du hast ein Auge dafür, was gut aussieht, und traust dich an ein Design-Tool.
  • Extrem schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Neue Tools lernst du in Tagen.
  • Ehrgeiz und Eigenantrieb: Du nimmst Feedback an und wirst mit jeder Woche besser.
  • Du gehst selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools um.
  • Du schreibst gut und schnell. Texte, die verkaufen, nicht Texte, die nur schön klingen.
  • Du willst das ganze Ding verantworten, nicht nur deinen Teil davon.

Figma, Newsletter oder Designausbildung? Kein Muss.

Auge, Tempo und Einstellung entscheiden. Den Rest bringen wir dir bei.

Benefits

  • Kein internes Ping-Pong. Du gibst deinen Text nicht weiter und wartest, was zurückkommt. Du baust den Newsletter selbst zu Ende.
  • Der ganze Newsletter gehört dir: Text, Aufbau, Bildwelt. Du gibst die Richtung vor.
  • Deine Arbeit geht raus. An echte Kunden echter Marken, nicht in eine Ablage. Und du kriegst mit, wie sie gelaufen ist.
  • 30 bis 40 Marken parallel. In einem Jahr machst du hier mehr Kampagnen als woanders in fünf.
  • 3.500 bis 6.000 € im Monat. Ziel jeder Einstellung ist die unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Modernes Büro in Düsseldorf Pempelfort mit Dachterrasse und ÖPNV-Anschluss.
  • Beste Hardware von Apple, höhenverstellbare Tische.
  • Junges Team und Geschäftsführung
  • Pluxee Card
  • Urban-Sports-Mitgliedschaft
  • Apple-Hardware
  • Aktive Arbeit mit modernster KI
  • Monatliche Teamevents

Rügamer & Steiner ist eine inhabergeführte Agentur für E-Mail- & CRM-Marketing im E-Commerce, gegründet von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner in Düsseldorf. Wir bauen für über 150 Online-Shops im DACH-Raum E-Mail-Marketing, das wirklich Umsatz bringt. Wir messen uns an Ergebnissen, nicht an Stunden und bringen jeden weiter, der bereit ist, dafür zu arbeiten.

WICHTIG: Wer ausschließlich als Freelancer arbeiten will, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht nur Richtlinien schreiben, du willst die komplette Sicherheitsarchitektur in der Cloud bauen und verantworten. Du willst nicht nur Berichte abliefern, du willst Audits von ISO 27001 und BSI‑C5 eigenständig bestehen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Dokumentation, hier geht es um Hands‑On‑Arbeit mit Terraform, AWS und GCP. Hier geht es nicht um einen starren 9‑to‑5‑Job, hier geht es um eine 32‑Stunden‑Option, Equity und direkten Einfluss auf die Gründer.

Ein Berliner HealthTech‑Startup mit rund zehn Mitarbeitenden, das KI‑gestützte Software zur Automatisierung psychotherapeutischer Dokumentation entwickelt. Die Plattform entlastet Therapeuten von administrativen Aufgaben und verbessert die Patientenversorgung. Das Unternehmen positioniert sich als innovativer Anbieter im Schnittfeld von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Gesundheits‑ und Software‑Technologie.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

Hohe Verantwortung – End‑to‑End‑Ownership über Security & Compliance.

Technische Hands‑On‑Arbeit – Cloud‑Security und IaC mit Terraform.

Stabiles Vollzeit‑Umfeld mit 32‑Stunden‑Option.

Equity‑Beteiligung über VESOP.

Direkter Einfluss – täglicher Kontakt zu Gründern und CTO.

  • Own security & compliance end‑to‑end: Cloud, Produkt und interne IT.

  • Erfahrung mit DevSecOps, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling und Vulnerability Management.
  • Fließende Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C1).

  • Freelancer – keine langfristige Anstellung.

Benefits

  • Team‑Events und ein inklusives Arbeitsklima
  • Attraktives Gehalt bis zu 100 k €

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Vollständige Ownership über Security & Compliance in einem wachsenden HealthTech‑Startup.
  • Breites Hands‑On‑Spektrum von Cloud‑Hardening bis Audit‑Leitung – steile Lernkurve garantiert.
  • Direkter, täglicher Austausch mit Gründer:innen & CTO ohne Hierarchien.

What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?

raw.title: Lead Implementation & Delivery (f/m/d)
raw.description:
We're looking for an experienced implementation, delivery or technical operations lead to own delivery after a contract is signed — and to play a central role in working out what actually makes our product work for customers.

This one is for you if:

  • You'd rather build the playbook than wait for one to exist
  • You get real satisfaction from being the person people can count on — customers and colleagues alike
  • Making a genuinely complex, technical product work in the real world, on a factory floor and not just a slide deck, sounds like a good problem to have

Every factory should be as easy to redesign as a CAD file. RIIICO scans real production floors and turns the raw point cloud into a structured, living model of the plant — machines, robots and infrastructure recognised by AI, matched to CAD, usable directly in the engineering tools our customers already run. Line changes that used to take months of manual work now take days.

We're seed-funded, backed by Earlybird, PiLabs and seed + speed, with angels including Joe Kaeser, former CEO of Siemens.

Team: two application engineers report to you directly, and you steer our data delivery team, which has its own manager and five people.
Start: as soon as you can.

Tasks

You'll own the entire post-sale delivery, from signed deal to a customer who's live, confident and getting real value. Our customers are enterprise manufacturers, so the accounts you own are complex and technically demanding from day one. As an early hire there's no existing playbook — expect to blend hands-on implementation, delivery operations and testing product-market-fit hypotheses directly with customers.

  • Own the post-sale journey, from handover through to stable, value-delivering adoption
  • Build the adoption framework for enterprise accounts, and define what "first value" means
  • Keep a current view of every account: check-ins, early risk signals, retention plans
  • Handle escalations yourself, at both operational and management level
  • Own the Sales-to-delivery handover and keep capacity visible and realistic
  • Develop the lightweight processes that make delivery repeatable as patterns emerge
  • Lead and develop your team, and shape how Delivery is structured as we grow
  • Test the product-market-fit hypotheses Sales brings back, and feed findings into Product and Go-To-Market

What this looks like in your first six months:

  • Months 1–2 — run two live enterprise implementations yourself, end to end, so you know where the product and the process actually break
  • Months 2–3 — take over the Sales-to-delivery handover and make capacity visible enough that Sales doesn't promise what delivery can't back up
  • Months 3–4 — define what "first value" means for an enterprise account, and the timeframe we hold ourselves to
  • Months 4–6 — turn what you've learned into the first delivery playbook, and bring at least two validated product-market-fit findings back to Product and Sales

Requirements

  • 4–6 years in technical implementation, delivery, project lead or technical operations roles, at a B2B company serving manufacturing or industrial customers
  • Experience as an early hire building implementation or delivery processes from scratch in a startup or scale-up
  • Experience owning the interface between Sales and a technical delivery team: handover, capacity oversight, and escalations you resolved independently
  • Enough technical depth to get fluent fast in discrete manufacturing, factory planning or industrial automation. You don't need to have done this exact thing before, but you do need to hold a credible conversation with a manufacturing engineer within a few months
  • Fluent written and spoken German and English. We work in English internally; customer work happens in German

You're eligible to work in Germany — EU/EEA citizenship, or an existing work or residence permit. We aren't able to sponsor visas for this role.

You'll fit if:

  • You're decisive and comfortable holding your ground when Sales pushes on scope or timeline — and just as good at negotiating a pragmatic trade-off without compromising commitments already made
  • You're pragmatic and action-first: you build the process as the pattern emerges, rather than designing the system before you understand the reality
  • You have commercial instinct: you notice what's working and bring it to Sales as an expansion opportunity
  • You're a fast learner with strong situational awareness, equally comfortable on a shop floor and in front of a senior stakeholder

Benefits

  • Real ESOP — actual shares, not virtual ones
  • 30 days' holiday
  • Deutschlandticket
  • Based in our Düsseldorf office, with the flexibility to work from home
  • Regular customer site visits — a genuine mix of factory floor and desk, not travel every week
  • Real ownership from day one, with a direct line to founders and leadership on decisions that matter
  • The chance to define what this function becomes as we grow
  • A diverse, international team

Apply with your CV — no cover letter needed.

How the process runs:

  1. Short intro call — 30 minutes
  2. Written questions by email — about 20 minutes of your time
  3. Deep-dive with Felix and the delivery team — 60 minutes
  4. Meet the team, then offer

The written questions are how we get to know how you think before anyone sits in a room. They're the reason we don't ask for a cover letter.

We are an employer that actively lives equal opportunity. We're committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. It doesn't matter where you're from, what religion you belong to, your gender, who you love, how old you are, or whether you live with a disability — you're welcome here.

Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken: </strong>Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner: </strong>Wir kümmern uns um dich. In unseren Hubs steht dir jederzeit ein gut gefüllter Kühlschrank mit frischen Snacks, Getränken und Obst zur Verfügung – damit du bestens versorgt bist, wenn dich der Hunger packt.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. You will spend most of your first six months in Iterable and the CDP. You will write the flow logic, set up the data pipes, design the experiments, and ship the AI agents that take work out of building, testing, and reporting on flows. The Director, CRM owns the retention strategy and the campaign calendar. You own the triggered flow programme that runs alongside it.</p> <p>Two constraints shape this job. UK and EU privacy rules mean the US lifecycle playbook does not transfer unchanged: you will rebuild the identity-resolution layer and shift weight toward logged-in and app behaviour. Channel economics also differ across markets, with SMS in particular materially more expensive in Europe than in the US, so the sequencing of email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market is not the same as the US default.</p> <p>You will be joining a team that values speed, candor, and rigour. This role is for you if you like building things, you can hold a roadmap in one hand and a SQL query in the other, and you have an opinion on how AI changes lifecycle work over the next 18 months.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Build, launch, and own every triggered lifecycle flow for UK (July 2026), DE (October 2026), and FR (November 2026): welcome, browse abandon, cart abandon, post-purchase, low stock, back in stock, win-back, replenishment, care instructions.</li> <li>Partner with MarTech to Ship AI agents and tooling that take work out of flow build, copy, segmentation, and QA. Target at least one end-to-end CRM agent in production by EoY1 and a 50% reduction in flow concept-to-deployment time within 90 days.</li> <li>Partner with the Data team to run the triggered-flow testing roadmap with statistically sound design. Minimum 6 A/B tests per quarter per flow per market.</li> <li>Build channel-cost decision logic across email, SMS, push, and in-app per flow per market.</li> <li>Recover signal lost from fingerprinting and consent restrictions in UK/EU by pushing app and logged-in routing for non-consenting users.</li> <li>Stand up and run the localisation pipeline with freelance copywriters for EN-UK, DE, and FR. Localised flow content live before each market launch.</li> <li>Partner with tech team to maintain CDP quality across UK/EU: data model, integrations (Iterable, Attentive, app SDK, site events), data hygiene, latency, and identity-resolution accuracy.</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2753" data-local-id="9ae6a13b-2175-4a37-a4c2-5839b2f592ae"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Qualifications</span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2769" data-local-id="46937c2f-d543-4fbd-b76c-3593c6541fb4"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Required: </span></strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years lifecycle/CRM marketing in DTC or ecommerce, including at least 3 years owning automated/triggered flows end to end (not campaign/blast).</li> <li>Hands-on with Iterable (preferred), or comparable ESP (Braze, Klaviyo, SFMC). Must have built flows in the tool, not just briefed them.</li> <li>Hands-on with a CDP: Segment, mParticle, Hightouch, Census, or similar. Must understand identity resolution and data hygiene.</li> <li>Has built or deployed AI agents or LLM workflows in a marketing context (copy, segmentation, flow logic, QA). If you have not shipped one yet, you can describe the one you would ship in your first 90 days here.</li> <li>SQL proficient. Can self-serve in Looker, Lookr, or BigQuery without waiting for an analyst.</li> <li>A/B testing rigour. Knows what statistical significance means and where it breaks in lifecycle (sample size, primary metric selection, novelty effects).</li> <li>Working knowledge of UK/EU privacy law (GDPR, PECR) and consent management. Understands what changes operationally when fingerprinting is restricted.</li> <li>Detail-oriented. Triggered flows live or die on edge cases (locale, currency, time zone, opt-in state, suppression rules).</li> <li>Strong cross-functional operator. Will work daily with creative, brand, data science, tech, and US CRM counterparts.</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3083" data-local-id="dbaae2d5-3e8d-43bb-be8c-e1c7e3b63382"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Preferred:&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul class="ak-ul" data-local-id="20322c78-4bdc-4d7a-af35-387a22f0e7ab" data-indent-level="1"> <li><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Multi-market lifecycle experience (UK + DE or FR), fashion or home goods background, app-native lifecycle experience, fluency in DE or FR.</span></li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3150"><em><span style="font-size: 11px;">All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. </span></em><em><span style="font-size: 11px;">Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.</span></em></p></div><div class="title">Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£80,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£90,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">WHY QUINCE?</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3352">Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3604"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u data-renderer-mark="true">EQUAL OPPORTUNITY &amp; HIRING INTEGRITY</u></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="3662">Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.&nbsp;</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4074">Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="4428">Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. We're building the platform that runs underneath.</strong></p> <p>Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for <strong>10,000+ businesses worldwide</strong>, from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.</p> <p>We're <strong>100 people</strong>, <strong>profitable</strong>, and have raised <strong>€18M in funding</strong> (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). description: <h2><strong>Über uns: Wer/Was ist Artefact?</strong></h2> <p>Artefact ist eine weltweit führende Beratung für Daten- und KI-Dienstleistungen mit Hauptsitz in Paris. Mit mehr als 2.000 Consultants, Data Scientists und Engineers in 26 Ländern arbeiten wir mit den globalen Marktführern zusammen. An unseren deutschen Standorten befinden wir uns auf einem rasanten Wachstumskurs. Wir beraten führende nationale und internationale Kunden branchenübergreifend dabei, das volle Potenzial ihrer Daten auszuschöpfen, skalierbare Datenarchitekturen aufzubauen und innovative KI-Lösungen zu implementieren.</p> <p>Als <strong data-path-to-node="4" data-index-in-node="4">Senior Consultant (m/w/d) Data &amp; AI Strategy</strong> stehst du im Mittelpunkt dieser Mission. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von fokussierten Kurzzeit-Projekten im gehobenen Mittelstand bis hin zu mehrphasigen KI-Transformationen in Großkonzernen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die Verantwortung für crossfunktionale Workstreams, treibst datenbasierte Entscheidungen voran und gestaltest die digitale Zukunft unserer Kunden aktiv mit.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich bei uns:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Kundenberatung &amp; Strategie:</strong> Du arbeitest eng mit (internationalen) Kunden zusammen, verstehst deren geschäftliche Anforderungen und übersetzt diese in datengestützte Empfehlungen, die strategische Entscheidungen und die Business Transformation unterstützen.</li> <li><strong>Daten &amp; Analyse:</strong> Du sammelst, strukturierst und bereitest Daten für Analysen auf. Mit Tools wie Excel, SQL und Python identifizierst du Trends, Muster und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen und kommunizierst diese klar an technische sowie nicht-technische Stakeholder.</li> <li><strong>Projektumsetzung:</strong> Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Projekt-Workstreams und stellst eine qualitativ hochwertige, termingerechte Lieferung im Einklang mit den übergeordneten Projektzielen sicher. Dabei arbeitest du kollaborativ in interdisziplinären Teams aus den Bereichen Consulting, Data und Tech.</li> <li><strong>Daten- &amp; KI-Lösungen:</strong> Du unterstützt die Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, KI-Use-Cases sowie Business-Intelligence-Lösungen und wirkst bei Governance-Frameworks und Implementierungs-Roadmaps mit.</li> <li><strong>Wissenstransfer &amp; Kollaboration:</strong> Du trägst zu einer starken Teamkultur bei, indem du dein Wissen teilst, dich über digitale Trends und KI-Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden hältst und die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des Teams unterstützt.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit:</strong></h2> <p>Im Kern definieren wir uns über eine Kultur der Eigenverantwortung, der intellektuellen Neugier und der Zusammenarbeit. Wir suchen motivierte, fähige und umsichtige Talente, die hungrig auf neue Herausforderungen sind und die Chance nutzen wollen, zu lernen und zu wachsen.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Berufserfahrung:</strong> Du verfügst über mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Management-/Datenberatung oder in einer entsprechenden Inhouse-Funktion. Zudem bringst du nachweisbare Erfolge in den Bereichen Daten-/KI-Strategie, Cloud-Transformation oder angewandte KI-/Machine-Learning-Projekte mit.</li> <li><strong>Daten- &amp; KI-Verständnis:</strong> Du besitzt eine hohe Affinität für Datenmanagement und moderne KI-Technologien. Team description

The Hardware tribe builds the technology that turns everyday devices into secure, reliable card readers, from Bluetooth-connected dongles to fully in-house Tap to Pay on Android. You'll join a team solving genuinely hard problems: keeping payments working across flaky Bluetooth connections, handling online and offline flows without losing a transaction. It's a chance to go deep on Android engineering in a space where reliability really matters, since every merchant depends on these readers to get paid.

What you'll do

  • Build and maintain Android applications for card readers, SDKs, and the SuperApp, covering both new features and improvements to existing systems

  • Work on Bluetooth Low Energy connections, online and offline payment flows, and Tap to Pay functionality

  • Refactor and modernise legacy code to improve reliability, performance, and maintainability

  • Contribute to testing practices, including unit and integration tests, to raise overall code quality

  • Collaborate with peers and stakeholders across the team to manage priorities and shape solutions to technical challenges

You'll be great for this role if...

  • Several years of professional Android development experience, with solid proficiency in both Java and Kotlin

  • Strong knowledge of clean architecture principles and hands-on experience maintaining Android SDKs

  • Experience of writing unit and integration tests, and comfort refactoring legacy code without breaking existing functionality

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions, and an interest in improving build and release processes

  • Ability to adapt to ambiguity and shifting priorities, with strong communication skills for working independently with stakeholders

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Location: THG Labs, Commerce park, Cornbrash, Frome BA11 2FN</strong></p> <p><strong>Shift Pattern: Rotating shifts – 6am - 2:15pm / 2pm - 10:15pm, 8.15 hour a day, 41.25 hours per week</strong></p> <p><strong>About THG Labs</strong></p> <p>THG acquired Acheson &amp; Acheson in 2018 to bring full service, product development &amp; manufacturing in-house to supply innovative branded and THG Beauty Brand products to the industry. In 2022 Acheson &amp; Acheson became THG Labs. Capabilities include:</p> <ul> <li>In-house market knowledge &amp; trends</li> <li>End-to-end service from idea generation through to manufacturing and launch</li> <li>Technical, commercial and production expertise</li> <li>Outstanding customer service</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a proactive and versatile Maintenance Engineer with strong mechanical expertise and sound electrical knowledge to join our fast-paced engineering team. The successful candidate will play a key role in maintaining, diagnosing, and repairing a wide range of production and site equipment to ensure maximum operational efficiency and minimal downtime.</p> <p><strong>As a Multi-Skilled Engineer you will:<br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance on mechanical and electrical systems, including conveyors, gearboxes, pumps, motors, bearings, pneumatic systems, hydraulic equipment, and automated machinery.</li> <li>Diagnose mechanical faults and complete repairs in accordance with safety standards and manufacturers’ guidelines.</li> <li>Undertake equipment strip-downs, component replacements, alignments, adjustments, and rebuilds.</li> <li>Perform basic electrical fault-finding and safely isolate equipment when required.</li> <li>Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to engineering projects aimed at improving equipment reliability, performance, and efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain accurate maintenance records using the company’s CMMS system.</li> <li>Ensure compliance with all relevant Health &amp; Safety, environmental, and quality standards.</li> <li>Provide technical support and collaborate closely with production and operations teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What skills and experience do I need for this role?<br></strong></p> <p><strong>Essential Requirements:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Time-served apprenticeship or relevant engineering qualification (NVQ Level 3, ONC, or HNC) in Mechanical or Multi-Skilled Maintenance Engineering.</li> <li>Proven experience in a similar maintenance engineering role within a manufacturing, FMCG, or industrial environment.</li> <li>Strong mechanical fault-finding and diagnostic skills, with practical experience working on bearings, gearboxes, pumps, conveyors, pneumatics, and hydraulics.</li> <li>Sound electrical knowledge, including motors, sensors, control systems, and safe electrical isolation.</li> <li>Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical diagrams, and schematics.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving ability and attention to detail.</li> Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to join our London team. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role: services and integrations, identity and access automation, observability, reliability and developer experience. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on

  • Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work

  • Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling

  • Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production

  • Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same reliability and governance bar as anything else we ship

  • Raise the engineering bar on the team, from service design and code review to testing, CI/CD and documentation, and improve the developer experience for everyone building on the platform

We're excited about you because…

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems

  • Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts

  • Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes

  • Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not

  • End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt

  • Experience automating identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed features to real users (retrieval, grounding and evaluation), or with MCP, agent frameworks or tool-calling in production

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

  • Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead

  • Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

  • Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with Omada.ai. Who handles your social media?"

  • Show a quick demo on your phone

  • Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them

  • Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

  • People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

  • UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom

  • Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC

  • Smartphone with internet access

  • Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density

  • Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

  • Show a quick demo on your phone

  • Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them

  • Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

  • People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
description: The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents. The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes. We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue. Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand. What You Own • Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment. • Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing. • Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test. • Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis. • Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts. • Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments. • Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team. What This Role Is Not • It is not a traditional marketing leadership job. • It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role. • It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists. • It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate; This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority. Important: This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract. This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany. Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you: Highly competitive salary + Bonus Fully remote work environments. Self-managed time off. Who We Want • You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue. • You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility. • You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy, enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius. • You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection. • You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount. • You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality. • You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees. Strong Background Signals • Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories. • Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit. • Large-company titles alone are not compelling. Anti-Profile • Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team." • You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery. • You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention. • You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling. • You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system. • You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement. First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome • 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge. • 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay. • 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion. How Success Is Measured • Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics. • Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals, retention and expansion. • Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion. • Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected. Operating Model and Reporting This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth. Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles. Security Expectations You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege, deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated. Compensation Philosophy We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value. The Test A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to execute the work with minimal human headcount. description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it. What You'll Do Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust. Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline. Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes. Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums. Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search. Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health. Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects. Who You Are You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users). You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness. You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search. You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization. You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives. You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners. You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines. You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms. You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals. You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems. Where You'll Be This role is based in London or Stockholm.
